Question: Aslamulaikum, Dear Scholar As may u know that nowadays the chicken meet imports from foreign countries. America is an exporter country from those country which export the chicken meat. We found a Video that there is not observance of Islamic rule in the time of slaughtering for getting confidence prove u can watch the video. http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b6hidxtM5m4 This company chicken meet imports to our country so now Is it Halal chicken meat or Haram. Thanks Answer ID: 20907 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 408/408/M=1431) If the chicken imported from foreign countries is not slaughtered according to Islamic method it is not lawful to eat. Until one is not sure about being it halal one should avoid eating it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
